sentences.en: Ultraviolet line method was adopted to identify Aristolochia manshuriensis kom. , Clematis armandii Franch. and Akebia trifoliata koidz. Their peak values and absorption coefficients were detected.

sentences.en: For instance, aristolochia, which destroyed Sandra’s and Patricia’s lives, is still being sold to unwitting British patients, despite being legally banned.
